hypotheses.name: Fabry disease
hypotheses.summary: Multisystem findings including neuropathic pain, hypohidrosis, cornea verticillata, proteinuria, and cardiac findings raise consideration for Fabry disease, though leukocyte enzyme testing can be normal in heterozygous females and the diagnosis remains unconfirmed.

hypotheses.name: Idiopathic small fiber neuropathy
hypotheses.summary: Small fiber neuropathy with associated autonomic features and pain can occur without an identified systemic cause, though systemic manifestations remain unconfirmed to share this single etiology.
